display_long_description:
Turn your room into a dynamic coin-catching arena without even leaving your chair!

**Coin Catch & Fit** is an energetic Mixed Reality arcade game designed to give you a fun physical workout right from the comfort of your seat. Watch gold coins roll down virtual ramps in your real-world room and test your reaction time, precision, and endurance.

### Key Features:

- **Sit & Workout:** Enjoy an engaging upper-body and arm session without standing up. Extend and retract your arms to catch every coin before it falls!
- **Immersive Mixed Reality:** Built specifically for Passthrough MR, bringing interactive virtual physics seamlessly into your actual environment.
- **Intuitive Hand Tracking:** Experience natural controls using your own hands—no controllers needed!
- **Fast-Paced Fitness Arcade:** Combine high-score chasing with a light, active cardio exercise that boosts your reflexes and coordination.
- **Quick Physical Breaks:** Perfect for a short, invigorating session during your work day or casual gaming downtime.

Dodge traps, rack up high scores, and enjoy a rewarding fitness-arcade experience right from your favorite chair!
